evidence.quote: In the first quarter of Nvidia's fiscal year 2027, ending April 26, the company grew revenue 85% year over year, while diluted earnings per share soared by 140%.
evidence.one_line: Author reports Nvidia's Q1 FY2027 revenue grew 85% year over year and diluted EPS rose 140%.
evidence.speaker: Bram Berkowitz (fool.com)

evidence.quote: In March, CEO Jensen Huang said he expects the company's Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips to generate $1 trillion in sales between that time and the end of 2027.
evidence.one_line: CEO Jensen Huang said in March he expects Blackwell and Vera Rubin chips to generate $1 trillion in sales through end-2027.
evidence.speaker: Jensen Huang

evidence.quote: Management said they think they can generate nearly $20 billion of CPU sales, making it an instant industry leader.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia management said it expects to generate nearly $20 billion of CPU sales after entering the CPU space.
evidence.speaker: Nvidia management

evidence.quote: Cerebras already has chips it claims are 15 times faster than some of Nvidia's models.
evidence.one_line: Cerebras claims its chips are 15 times faster than some Nvidia models.
evidence.speaker: Cerebras (as reported by author)

evidence.quote: Wall Street consensus estimates suggest the company will earn adjusted earnings per share of $8.97 in its current fiscal year.
evidence.one_line: Wall Street consensus estimates Nvidia adjusted EPS of $8.97 in the current fiscal year.
evidence.speaker: Wall Street consensus (as reported by author)

evidence.quote: Nvidia has had an average forward price-to-earnings ratio of nearly 34 for the past two years.
evidence.one_line: Nvidia has averaged a forward P/E of nearly 34 over the past two years.
evidence.speaker: Bram Berkowitz (fool.com)

candidates.question: Will Nvidia's FY2027 total revenue reach the level implied by the 85% first-quarter growth pace, with the outcome judged against prior-year revenue?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue growth at or above 85%

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue growth from 50% up to but not including 85%

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue growth from 25% up to but not including 50%

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: FY2027 total revenue growth from 0% up to but not including 25%

candidates.looks_at: Blackwell and Vera Rubin product revenue
candidates.question: Will Nvidia's Blackwell and Vera Rubin product revenue in FY2027 reach the $1 trillion cumulative sales level Huang cited through end-2027?

rungs.label: Strongly bullish
rungs.condition: Blackwell+Rubin product revenue in FY2027 at or above 500 billion USD

rungs.label: Bullish
rungs.condition: Blackwell+Rubin product revenue in FY2027 from 350 billion up to but not including 500 billion USD

rungs.label: Neutral
rungs.condition: Blackwell+Rubin product revenue in FY2027 from 200 billion up to but not including 350 billion USD

rungs.label: Bearish
rungs.condition: Blackwell+Rubin product revenue in FY2027 from 100 billion up to but not including 200 billion USD

rungs.label: Strongly bearish
rungs.condition: Blackwell+Rubin product revenue in FY2027 below 100 billion USD

candidates.settled_by: Nvidia FY2027 annual report (10-K) product revenue disclosure
